checks.text: No known asteroid, comet, planet or moon was predicted within 2′ of it at its 2 dot times (MPC orbits of 1,580,438 asteroids at any brightness and 2,215 comets, seen from SPHEREx).

checks.text: The known asteroid 2011 AH101 (MPC orbit, V 24.3) was predicted 107″ to the west of it, moving 21″ an hour toward PA 80°; ours moves 118″ an hour toward PA 260°. Not a certain match: it is 112″ off at the farthest dot, the speeds differ, the directions differ by 179°.
checks.look: On the hours clock in D5, step through its exposures and look 107″ to the west: if a second moving dot runs there, that is 2011 AH101 and ours is something else; if not, ours may be 2011 AH101 slightly off its predicted place.
